hint: Try writing $32$ as a power of $2$ so both sides share a base.

hints.text: Try writing $32$ as a power of $2$ so both sides share a base.
Since $32 = 2^5$, the equation becomes $2^x = 2^5$. Compare the two exponents on the matching bases.
Equal bases mean equal exponents, so $x = 5$.

explanation: The same-base method rewrites both sides as powers of the SAME base.
Here $32 = 2^5$, so the equation becomes $2^x = 2^5$ with the same base on each side.
When the bases match, the exponents must match too, so $x = 5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Take a log of both sides
steps: A log and a power with the same base undo each other, so the left side is just $x$.
